notes: Governmental activities are on a modified cash basis; business-type (electric, water, sewer) on accrual basis. Basis set to cash; governmental roll-forward uses fund balance (beginning 6,221,087 to ending 6,656,769, equal to total governmental assets p4). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); total revenues 10,457,446 printed includes Bond/loan proceeds 3,073,038 (General 100,000 + CDA 2,973,038), which are recorded as debt_proceeds and not in receipts; receipts therefore sum to 7,384,408. Sale of assets 258,201 kept in receipts as printed within revenues. Transfers in (out) net to zero in the total column (not recorded). Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7), Total column; no single total printed, so totals computed. Loss on sale of assets (36,087) recorded as business_type.other_financing; roll: 25,415,819 + 18,416,312 - 8,925,094 - 36,087 = 34,870,950. Contribution in aid of construction 6,656,517 and grant income 5,132,358 are kept in receipts because they are printed in nonoperating revenues. Proprietary statement of cash flows (p8; its continuation, the operating-income reconciliation, is p9, gained in the v7 re-trim and adds nothing new) not recorded in the proprietary field because the basis is not GAAP. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1), accrual/modified cash mix. Detail: for the General Fund the departmental combining schedule (pp17-18) is recorded rather than the General Fund budget comparison (p10), as it is more detailed: revenues from its Total column (p18), expenditures per department (pp17-18); loan proceeds 100,000 is printed within total revenues so it is an 'other financing' line and the revenue total carries includes other financing; transfers net (1,068,659) is printed below the revenue/expenditure totals, so it carries outside_printed_total. Mixed-object lines like 'Salaries and benefits' mapped to salaries and wages; 'Transportation' mapped to dues, training and travel; 'Capital outlay' to equipment purchases (object not described). CDA bond/loan proceeds likewise in other financing with includes. Nonmajor Capital Projects fund has no activity (all dashes). Budget_final is original and final budget (same). Enterprise fund schedules other than statements are not included in the report. Read pages 1-18 of 18 General Fund Departments capital outlay lines (Administrative 35,756, Police 239,868, Pool 5,383, Auditorium 18,000 = 299,007) take category capital outlay, matching the statement's separate General Fund Capital outlay line (p5), whose function lines exclude them (e.g. Police 992,235 - 239,868 = Public safety 752,367).
